candidates.summary: publishedKinds cuts the ExtensionKindsUpTo(limit) window before dropping view-less hooks, so Register's maxEventKinds guard, the register event's extension list and the badge row all answer from the issuer's first N registrations, not from the kinds the collection publishes
candidates.failure_scenario: An issuer registers 17 hook-only extensions (RegisterExtension(h, nil)) then any number of view-backed kinds. Register: publishedKinds(token, 17) sees only the hooks, so the 'too many extensions' guard never fires (17 published kinds listed with cap 16) and the register event carries no 'extension' attr, while GetExtensionKinds returns the published kinds. Render: with 9 hooks first and one published kind, the page says '_core only_'. Each call reports success, so the indexer and the visitor cannot tell the wrong answer from the right one.
